name: @amlhubs/tei-p5
description: TEI P5 4.11.0 (linguistic subset) — Text Encoding Initiative Guidelines for Electronic Text Encoding and Interchange. TypeScript metaclasses for the linguistic-encoding modules: dictionaries, linguistics, analysis, corpus, gaiji, namesdates, transcr — covering ~80 element types out of TEI P5's ~600. Other modules (manuscripts, drama, verse, certainty, figures, etc.) are deferred to subsequent versions.
